content.comment_body: I need to modify the pulse time of an asynchronous timer through the extended web server interface. When I enter 1 minute on the webpage, it changes the timer TH parameter to 5:00 minutes instead. The parameter is mapped as VB-4 Hex writable both on the web page and in [product_name] software. I have uploaded my project and HTTPS files. Thank you.

Hello [user_name], I'm happy to help, but there's a minor issue. I have LWE version [version_no] installed, while you use an older LWE version. If I modify your project, I'll need to upgrade it, and you won't be able to open it with your older LWE version. My suggestion: Please update your LWE software.
No problem. I've now updated my software to the latest version, v[version_no].
I have now updated your project and made some changes.
I've attached the upgraded LWE project and a new version of the [product_name] program.

Thank you very much! I've spent all night searching and reading documentation. I've learned more from your guidance and this forum than from the manuals. I realized I was using the Analog value function instead of Scale Time.
With LWE version [version_no], some functions are improved or new options are available ...

analysis.insight_summary: The user experienced a discrepancy between the entered timer value on the web interface and the resulting parameter in the asynchronous timer. This was caused by incorrect function selection (Analog value instead of Scale Time) and incompatible software versions between users. After upgrading the software and using the correct function, the issue was resolved with assistance from another forum member.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the timer pulse value entered on the web page to match the device parameter accurately. They seek reliable and straightforward setup of timer options using the configuration tools.
